smbd_deltas: confirmed per mariowiki: smbd replaces the nes warp-zone room's 3-pipe world-select with a room containing brick blocks, three ? blocks, 22 coins, and a power-up brick block - i.e. smbd 1-2 likely has no functional warp zone / world skip in this spot, or it is relocated elsewhere (not found in sources used). the warp_zone area entry and warps[] array above describe the NES layout; do not assume they apply unmodified to smbd until verified against the rom. total coin count also differs: 68 coins (nes) vs 90 coins (smbd challenge mode) per mariowiki, implying additional coins were added somewhere in the smbd layout beyond just the warp-zone-room replacement.
confidence_notes: this is the densest and most important level (warp zone) per the task brief. all x/y coordinates are sequence-derived placeholders per SCHEMA.md, not measured from map images - the warp zone pipe ordering (world 2/3/4 left-to-right) IS sourced/confirmed text, but the exact tile column of the room itself is approximate. the smbd warp-zone replacement is the single most important must-verify item in this whole file: mariowiki confirms it changed but does not describe the replacement room's exact block layout or whether smbd 1-2 has ANY way to skip worlds. do not build warp logic for smbd off the nes warps[] array without rom verification.
